options.name: asm_request_log
options.description: When C(true), includes ASM request log data. When C(false), excludes ASM request log data.

options.name: complete_information
options.description: Include complete (all applicable) information in the QKview.

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination on your local filesystem where you want to save the QKview.

options.name: exclude
options.description: Exclude various file from the QKview. Valid elements of the list include: all, audit, secure, bash_history.

options.name: exclude_core
options.description: Exclude core files from the QKview.

options.name: filename
options.description: Name of the QKview file to create on the remote BIG-IP.

options.name: force
options.description: If C(false), the file will only be transferred if the destination does not exist.

options.name: max_file_size
options.description: Maximum file size of the QKview file, in bytes. By default, no max file size is specified.

options.name: only_create_file
options.description: If C(true), the file is created on the device and not downloaded. The file will not be deleted by the module from the device.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the async interface to complete its task. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
